director.name: 凯文·卡斯特尔诺 Kevin Castellano

this_title: Ariel Rot: El Mundo de Ayer
introduction: After having surpassed half a century of life, Ariel carries a number of life experiences interesting enough to be collected in a documentary. How were your beginnings in the world of music with Tequila? What is your relationship with Andrés Calamaro today? What role have drugs played in your career? Throughout 35 minutes, "El Mundo de Ayer" will show the most intimate and personal side of the musician to the rhythm of some of the songs taht he played in his last concert in Valencia.
